description: Verifies Stripe, GitHub, Slack, Shopify or generic HMAC-SHA256 webhook signatures exactly as the provider computes them, with timestamp tolerance. Returns { provider, valid, timestamp?, age_s?, within_tolerance? } Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

payload.description: Raw request body exactly as received.

secret.description: Webhook signing secret. Use a test secret; it is not stored.

signature.description: Signature header value (Stripe-Signature, X-Hub-Signature-256, X-Slack-Signature, X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256, or hex/base64).

tolerance_s.description: Allowed clock skew for Stripe and Slack, default 300.

name: webhook-verify
title: Webhook signature verifier
